'''Fest Batar Stronghold''' was a base built by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in the [[Old Paths]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. The Gormak used the stronghold as a base for attacks on [[Voss (species)|Voss]] pilgriims along the nearby [[Road to Renewal]] in the [[Serenity Valley]] and the [[Shrine of Healing]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fest Batar Stronghold appears as a location on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
